### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s).

**34** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1ea3fe9eaa8cf43657cb66b119f6ed15ac43d19c`.

⛔ **12** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 48 pages)`, `organization_id (literal, 38 pages)`
- **10** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **2** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1ea3fe9eaa8cf43657cb66b119f6ed15ac43d19c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e660e5c39e4cc131898a8aac30b1aa07a530e1c0` — the merge of head `5b5f464ebfb64b208e1ef14f0971917ae689e12e` into base `1ea3fe9eaa8cf43657cb66b119f6ed15ac43d19c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e660e5c39e4cc131898a8aac30b1aa07a530e1c0 && git checkout e660e5c39e4cc131898a8aac30b1aa07a530e1c0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 1ea3fe9eaa8cf43657cb66b119f6ed15ac43d19c 5b5f464ebfb64b208e1ef14f0971917ae689e12e && git checkout -B drift-repro 1ea3fe9eaa8cf43657cb66b119f6ed15ac43d19c && git merge --no-ff 5b5f464ebfb64b208e1ef14f0971917ae689e12e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1ea3fe9eaa8cf43657cb66b119f6ed15ac43d19c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 1ea3fe9eaa8cf43657cb66b119f6ed15ac43d19c` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`

Local-runs: none
Scope: declaration face (`Clause-②: yes (widening: @object-ui/app-shell exports InvitationLinkHint and @object-ui/plugin-form exports useInitialFieldFocus; no accept set moves)`), the whole diff outside the prose faces: packages/platform-objects/src/identity/{sys-invitation,sys-member,sys-organization,sys-user}.object.ts, membership-role-help.ts and invitation-screens-copy.test.ts, the four generated translation bundles under src/apps/translations/, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/{ActionParamDialog,ActionConfirmDialog,ActionResultDialog}.tsx and actionDialogReturnFocus.ts with their two new tests, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/{LoginPage,invitationArrival}.tsx, src/console/organizations/manage/{AcceptInvitationPage,InvitationsPage}.tsx, src/index.ts, ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx, the ten i18n packs and their test, the adapted auth/organization tests, .changeset/27521-invitation-screens.md.

The reviewer is not the drafter (`session_01L9qibyekmZuiE5TVrwDWqH`).

Delta since the 2582296c review (claim 6529782482; re-claimed on this head): two commits. fa9836b0 merges origin/main 39da1bd6 (which carries the #28227 main-red fix): the PR's own hunks against the new merge base are byte-identical to the reviewed ones (39 files, same names, no content difference) and the merge touches no file the PR touches. 5b5f464e is test-only: `invitation-screens-copy.test.ts` now pins the whole `update_member_role` description, fallback included, so the should-fix below is resolved on this head.

### ① Derived judgments

- The declared widening is exact: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s barrel adds `InvitationLinkHint` (a component rendered by both sign-in pages), and `@object-ui/plugin-form`'s barrel re-exports the existing internal hook `useInitialFieldFocus`; neither name was exported on `main`. Nothing an existing importer sees changes.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` holds against the platform-object diff: every edit uses an authorable key the spec already declares — option `label` on `sys_invitation.status` (`Field.select({ options: [{ value, label }] })`, values unchanged, `rejected` labelled "Declined"), `helpText` on the role param of the six pickers (one `MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_PARAM_HELP` derived from `BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_OPTIONS`, typed on `BuiltinMembershipRole` so a new role fails to compile until explained), `description` on `resend_invitation` and `update_member_role`, `carryOver: true` beside the existing `defaultFromRow: true` on resend's two params (`carryOver` is a declared action-param contract, `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`), and `role` added to the `expired` list's `columns`. No stored value, enum member, action name or param set changes.
- Shared dialogs: `ActionParamDialog` now runs the object form's own format rule (`buildValidationRules` for `email` / `url`, via `resolveParamWidgetType`) after the required check and before the run, marking the field and skipping carried-over and empty values; help text keeps line breaks; the dialog opens on its first editable field and all three dialogs return focus to the opener through `useActionDialogReturnFocus` (document-level capture listeners that only record the last activated control; a disabled opener is waited for up to 10 s unless the user moves focus; no opener ⇒ Radix's default). These apply to every action's dialogs, which the changeset says.
- Invitation pages: the sign-in hint where sign-up is invitation-only, the accept page's joined state with Continue, "Keep invitation" on the workspace cancel dialog; four new i18n keys in all ten packs, pinned.
- Tests: `invitation-screens-copy.test.ts` pins labels, the help's one-line-per-role shape on all six pickers, the descriptions, resend's carried-over params and that every invitations list projects email and role, and the translated leaves' placeholders; the two app-shell test files (18 cases) pin the format check, required-over-format, carry-over skipping, line breaks, and the three focus-return openers with a control case. The ablations are the dev's report, read not re-run.
- Order: rows 7–11 (the invite half of 10) and 23; remainders named with their reasons (row 9's admin dismiss label needs a spec member on the confirm; row 11's pre-fill is a `needs_decision` against ADR-0138; row 10's Create User half is another card's), which is why the PR carries `Part of`.

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/plugin-form` **patch**: additive barrel exports with no accept set moving (the #28151 precedent). `@objectstack/platform-objects` **patch**: labels, help text, descriptions and a projected column on built-in objects, no authorable key and no stored value. `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/console` **patch**: added keys, a rendered hint. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.
- The three carriers agree: PR body, claim amendment 6529299111 and the changeset.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Behaviour reaching every declared action: the client-side format check refuses, before the run, an `email` / `url` param value the object form already refuses for the same field type; a server that accepted such a value for a custom action would now be reached only after the user fixes it. Disclosed in the changeset; the rule is the form's, so the two doors agree.
- Focus handling installs two capture-phase listeners on `document` once per document; they store one element reference and a timestamp, nothing else.
- Generated translation bundles regenerated and three leaves hand-translated; `check-i18n-bundles` reported clean in the dev's run.
- `Part of #27521`: remainders stay on the card as listed. Governed: none. Tier: +1247/-75 over 39 files, Tier S. Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` ⇒ no login note.

Should-fix, resolved by 5b5f464e on this head (the test now holds the whole sentence): `update_member_role`'s description reads `${record.user_id?.name ?? 'this member'}`, which depends on the list expanding `user_id`; where a future list shows the action without that expansion the fallback wording is the one users see, worth a pin on that list when it appears.

席位意见：Setup → Invitations 的六行建议中，这个 PR 做了能做的部分。邀请状态改显示标签（Pending / Accepted / Declined …），不再是原始小写值。所有授予角色的选择框共用一段说明，每个角色一行；Change Role 的说明会点名被改的成员。Resend 改为确认框，不再弹出可编辑的表单。控制台的动作对话框会先检查邮箱/网址参数，错误标在字段上；打开时焦点落在第一个可编辑字段，关闭后焦点回到打开它的按钮。在只能凭邀请注册的环境里，登录页会提示受邀人去打开邀请链接；接受邀请后，页面会告诉用户已加入哪个组织、担任什么角色。余下三项留在卡上（见第 3 条），所以本 PR 是 `Part of #27521`。

Metadata: `sys-invitation` / `sys-member` / `sys-organization` / `sys-user` objects plus the shared `membership-role-help.ts`, with the generated translation bundles. Row 11's email pre-fill is `needs_decision` against ADR-0138's amendment, where the signed-out preview masks the invited address. Row 10's Create User half is not done.
